sidebars.body_markdown: The issue is being made on the SME Platform of NSE (NSE EMERGE). [^drhp-p75] The objects are: (i) capital expenditure for a new facility at GIDC Waghodia, Vadodara, Gujarat; (ii) general corporate purposes; and (iii) creating a public market for shares. [^drhp-p75] The DRHP does not disclose the breakdown between fresh issue and offer for sale, the selling shareholders, the price band, or the total issue size.
